name: !Gã!ne
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

sources.note: Nothing on !Gã!ne prosody; ǁXegwi article reports a four-tone inventory for that (different) language.
Nothing on phonology; says the only material is 140 words collected from two semi-speakers in 1931 (Anders 1934-35); spoken near Tsolo and in Mthatha District.

sources.citation: du Plessis, Menán. 2009. A unity hypothesis for the Southern African Khoesan languages. PhD thesis, University of Cape Town.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Mentions Anders (1934-35) only as one of the 'fragmentary records (seeming to reflect idiolects of unknown dialects)' not placed in its classification table; nothing on !Gã!ne stress.

sources.citation: Bleek, Dorothea F. 1956. A Bushman Dictionary. American Oriental Series 41. New Haven: American Oriental Society.

sources.note: Incorporates Anders' !Gã!ne wordlist as dialect code 'SIIe !ga!ne, Transkei (Anders, H.)', 51 entries tagged (An.). No statement on stress for SIIe; only a language-general remark under 'n & ng': nasals are 'frequently found in unstressed second syllables and at the end of words'.

sources.note: Nothing; comment states '!Gã!ne, an extinct !Ui language only recorded by a vocabulary in Anders, H. 1934-1935'. Anders record typed 'wordlist', 9 pp., English.
